{{Quote|Surely you have more worthwhile ways to spend your energy. Let me get you another drink, and we'll be on our way. ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''A Likstro. ''[&hellip;]'' A large one.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and an Aqualish|<ref name="OBF" />}}
'''Likstro''' was a beverage [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by members of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="OBF" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> after [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] bumped into an [[Unidentified Aqualish (Panky's)|Aqualish]] and subsequently spilled [[Gender/Legends|his]] drink in the [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] [[Panky's]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Barlok system/Legends|Barlok system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]], Skywalker's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi Wan Kenobi]], [[Merchant/Legends|bought]] a large Likstro as an apology to the Aqualish.<ref name="OBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Likstro appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="OBF" />
